sourceRegistry.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
sourceRegistry.factSummary: OpenAI announced visual, interactive Chat answers. Paid-tier rollout starts October 7; Free and Go start October 8. Enterprise access depends on administrators. Work and Codex models are unchanged.

sourceRegistry.title: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
sourceRegistry.factSummary: College Planner is planned to organize application tasks and deadlines. It is coming soon without a launch date, initially for US grades 10–12 applying to four-year colleges; wider coverage is planned.

lessons.subtitle: October 7, 2026 · One step at a time
objectives: Describe a short list and a deadline.
Suggest a simple sequence of actions.
Distinguish a planned tool from a tool already available.
route: Say or write your own example · 5 min

sentences.english: OpenAI has a plan for a student tool.
The tool is called College Planner.
There is no fixed date yet.
Mona: I have lots of deadlines.
Karim: Shall we make a plan?
Mona: Yes, first we write a list.
Karim: And then we arrange the deadlines.
Mona: This deadline is tomorrow.
Karim: Okay, let’s start with this one.

concepts.title: Suggest a shared action
concepts.explanation: With these verbs, n- marks “we”: nekteb, “we write”, and neratteb, “we arrange”. In a question or suggestion, the same forms can mean “shall we…?” or “let’s…”. Put el-awwal (“first”) before the first action and wi-baʿdeen (“and then”) before the next.

examples.english: And then we arrange the deadlines.

concepts.title: This one and one step
concepts.explanation: Put da after a definite masculine noun and di after a definite feminine noun. With a feminine noun, “one” is waahda and normally follows it. There is no separate present-tense word for “is” in these descriptions.

lessons.title: Képek, gombok és számok
lessons.subtitle: October 7, 2026 · Pictures, buttons and numbers
objectives: Name parts of an interactive answer.
Say what you see and change.
route: Say or write your own example · 5 min

sentences.text: Az OpenAI új válaszokat mutat be.
sentences.english: OpenAI is introducing new responses.

sentences.text: A válaszban kép és gomb is lehet.
sentences.english: A response can also contain a picture and a button.
The rollout is gradual.
Anna: This is a simple calculator.
Bence: Where is the button?
Anna: Here it is.
Bence: I see the number.
Anna: I change the number.
Bence: Now the result is different.
Anna: Is the short answer enough?

sentences.text: Bence: Igen, de egy kép is segít.
sentences.english: Bence: Yes, but a picture helps too.
Anna: The button is small.
Bence: This button is bigger.
Anna: Now I see it.
Bence: Good, let’s try it!

concepts.title: A specific object: -t
concepts.explanation: Add an object ending when something is seen or changed. Szám becomes számot; kép becomes képet. With a specific object, learn the complete verb forms látom (“I see it”) and megváltoztatom (“I change it”). The object ending and the verb ending do different jobs.

concepts.title: Where it is; what it is like
concepts.explanation: Van appears when saying where something is: Itt van a gomb. For a third-person present description with an adjective, omit van: A gomb kicsi. Is means “also/too” and follows the item it includes.
